title: Neon Hourglass
summary: A raymarched WebGL2 hand-blown glass hourglass with brushed-brass pillars, a bioluminescent sand stream, and colored stone reflections.
description: A single-file WebGL2 SDF raymarching scene depicting a hand-blown glass hourglass framed by brushed-brass pillars and caps, a glowing bioluminescent sand stream feeding a growing lower cone, and colored reflections across a dark stone floor. Drag to orbit, wheel to zoom, press 1–3 for sand palettes, R for a 180-degree flip, Right Drag / Shift+Drag / L for the rim light, and Space to pause.
